descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Lines of Symmetry, Congruence, and Maps (E1.1-E1.5)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on spatial sense framed around Symmy the Symmetry Squirrel and Flippy the Folding Frog. Children sort by sides/angles/symmetry, conserve area, identify congruent shapes, make maps, and navigate a maze.
long_description: Discover symmetry and shape attributes with Symmy and Flippy! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 2 unit covers all 5 E1 expectations (E1.1-E1.5). Day 1 sorts shapes by sides, angles, and symmetry lines. Day 2 explores compose/decompose with area conservation. Day 3 introduces CONGRUENT shapes (matching by overlap, rotation OK). Day 4 makes simple maps from a bird's-eye view. Day 5 closes with a Mirror Maze Capstone where children navigate using verb + number directions. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-2 trap: corner-side mix-up, appearance-area conflation, rotation-not-allowed, side-view map, no-number directions), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 5-row summative rubric, and Junior Spatial Detective G2 certificates.
what_is_included: Manipulatives plan with 12 print-ready assets (1 file)
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day spatial sense unit (E1.1-E1.5).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on exploration with character-driven mirror frame, structured pair work, and Canadian context. Each lesson follows minds-on / action / consolidation arc with embedded formative checks and expanded walkthroughs.
